source.note: Header menu (#primary-site-navigation-desktop), site description and footer copyright, read from the public page. The menu's two parent items (Maps, Open Records) link to their first child on the live site; here they are group labels.

token_notes.tokens.accent: was #fbbf24, the site's prefers-contrast:more amber; now its default amber
token_notes.tokens.focus: was #fbbf24 (the high-contrast amber); now the site's own focus ring color
token_notes.tokens.font-body: was var(--dl-font-b,...), which needed the captured site CSS; now the stack itself, so the room needs no site stylesheet
token_notes.tokens.font-display: as font-body: the resolved site stack
token_notes.tokens.font-mono: as font-body: the resolved site stack
token_notes.tokens.ink-soft: was #a3b1c4, hand-picked; now the site's muted text
token_notes.tokens.link: was #7cb8fb, hand-picked; now the site's link blue
token_notes.tokens.on-accent: text on amber buttons; the site file has no on-amber color (9.22:1 on --dl-amber)
token_notes.tokens.page-bg: the room sits on dd's own page (--dl-bg); identity.backdrop gives that color for the contrast check
token_notes.tokens.page-ink-soft: was #a3b1c4, hand-picked and not in dd's palette; now the site's muted text (5.46:1 on the page, 4.63:1 on inputs)
token_notes.tokens.page-link: was #7cb8fb, hand-picked; now the site's link blue (7.31:1 on panels)
token_notes.tokens.radius: was 10px, between the site's two radii; now its standard --r
